<h2>About</h2>
<p>
 I am social scientist with a passion for qualitative and quantitative public health research concerning local food systems, food security, and social justice. 

As Research Analyst, I support the design, execution, and analysis of quantitative and qualitative research projects – synthesizing policy and raw data to develop high-quality written material for clients.

As a graduate student, I furthered my expertise in research methodology, with a focus on data science, public health theory, and community-engaged research.

With a background in mutual aid efforts between Black youth and Black Farmers in Atlanta, I am dedicated to uprooting oppressive systems, institutions, and practices while supporting initiatives that create food abundance for all people.
</p>
